name: collective_lambda_05
notes: Half of every agent's reward replaced by the population mean (r_i <- 0.5 r_i + 0.5 mean_j r_j), everything else neutral; the log keeps the raw -D and the shaped reward goes to shaped_reward.parquet. Expected fingerprint against neutral_anchor: the individual incentive is diluted, so per-agent drive equalises (a lower spread of mean drive across agents) and SOCIAL crowding redistributes, since presence at SOCIAL now pays through others' restored social need as well; contention per agent-day at the canteen falls if agents yield seats; the open question is whether the fingerprint diverges from neutral_anchor at all at this budget, or whether free-riding (own states mattering less) leaves the time budgets where they were with a higher mean drive. Either outcome is the finding.
